title: Kakegurui
source: Kakegurui manga by Homura Kawamoto and Toru Naomura (ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published arc.
world: At the elite Hyakkaou Private Academy, social rank is decided by gambling, and students who fall into debt become 'house pets'. Transfer student Yumeko Jabami gambles for the thrill of risk itself and shakes up the Student Council led by Kirari Momobami. A stylish, intense story of games, bluffs and wild expressions.
power_system: No powers. Gambles of every kind (cards, dice, votes) decide rank, debt and Student Council seats.

groups.name: Student Council
groups.line: Kirari Momobami and her members, who run the school through gambling.

terms.line: Student in debt, given a dog or cat name tag.
Everything at Hyakkaou is decided by betting.
